answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybil farms. Rewards for each identity vest over about 30 epochs and stay slashable until then. If a random jury later links an account to others, say clones named Atlas, Juniper and Jade sharing phrasing and timing, the whole cluster's unvested balance is burned. The attacker must fund weeks of fresh graded work per fake agent while capital stays frozen, so mass identities cost far more than they can safely withdraw.
